details.description: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is Meta's text-only instruction-tuned model in the Llama 3.x family, released December 6, 2024. Meta's own benchmark table shows it matching or approaching the much larger Llama 3.1 405B on several tasks while improving over Llama 3.1 70B on steerability, math and code. It is intended for multilingual assistant-like chat across eight languages and a 128K-token context window. AWS Bedrock's model card lists this model's lifecycle as Active.
advantages: Scores 92.1 on IFEval, up from 87.5 for Llama 3.1 70B, per Meta's model card.
Scores 77.0 on MATH (CoT), up from 68.0 for Llama 3.1 70B, per Meta's model card.
Scores 88.4 pass@1 on HumanEval, up from 80.5 for Llama 3.1 70B, per Meta's model card.
Scores 77.3 on the BFCL v2 tool-use benchmark, per Meta's model card.
Scores 91.1 on the multilingual MGSM benchmark, up from 86.9 for Llama 3.1 70B, per Meta's model card.
Supports eight languages (English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, Thai), per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
Text-only; no image or audio input, per Meta's and AWS Bedrock's model cards.
Meta's model card does not describe built-in tools (e.g. search or code execution); tool integration is left to developers.
use_cases: Model distillation (using this model's outputs to train other models)

notes: The catalog's max_input_tokens (128000) and max_output_tokens (4096) match both Meta's and AWS Bedrock's model cards (128K context, 4K max output). AWS Bedrock's model card (fetched 2026-09-24) lists this model's lifecycle as Active, with an 'EOL no sooner than' floor of Dec 6, 2025 that is not an announced retirement.
